plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence — Option 2 published on catalog p. 198 of the official 2024-2025 catalog; AA-T in Economics. Option 2 takes MATH 1 and MATH 50 together in Spring Y1; in the 2024-2025 catalog Summer is MATH 3A only and MATH 3B plus ECON 2 moved to Fall Y2 (which now lists MATH 3B, ECON 2, ECON 6, CIS 1, POSCI 1/26 and its printed total of 18 now matches the listed courses). 'Prereq for MATH 3A/3C' rows map to major (major preparation); 'US History'/'US/CA Politics' map to core. ECON 1/ECON 2 list only developmental-math prerequisites (MATH 203/211D/230), assumed satisfied at entry by placement — not coded; ECON 1 is explicitly not a prerequisite for ECON 2. ECON 6 requires ECON 1 and ECON 2 (coded). ENGL 5 requires ENGL 1A (coded). MATH 3A requires MATH 1 and MATH 50; MATH 3B requires MATH 3A; MATH 3C requires MATH 3B (all coded). The 2023-2024 catalog's Fall-term anomaly (printed total 18 vs 10 listed units) is resolved in 2024-2025: the moved courses make the printed 18 reconcile. Computed total at lower bound is 74. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750); sequence pages visually verified from the PDF. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
